people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”
translations.bsb: Then the Israelites received the report: “Behold, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar on the border of the land of Canaan, at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side.”
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar in the forefront of the land of Canaan, in the region about the Jordan, on the side that pertaineth to the children of Israel.
